## Standing operator rules
- “Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.”
- Run the “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” “in between your other work.” Execute all listed steps “in order, one at a time,” through US canary validation, then EU, then APAC.
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.”
- “the ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.”
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Continue the staged rollout with US canary validation, then EU and APAC in order. Fixing webhook signature verification remains the broader coding objective. Invoice pagination is superseded; scheduler and currency-rounding work are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Release: `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`; digest `sha256:8f1d2c3b4a5968778695a4b3c2d1e0f99887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa`.
- Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace: `payments`.
- Migration: `api-2-8-0-schema`; canary: `payments-api-rc3-canary`; deployment: `payments-api`.
- Final canary version: `2.8.0-rc.3`; `2.8.0-rc.2` is superseded.
- Runner: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.
- Credentials: `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`; prefix: `ledgerly_sbx`.
- Workers: `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`, `ledgerly/workers/usage_consumer.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate staging invoices and is “Not an option.”

## Recent work
US canary was created on rc.2, updated to rc.3, and rolled out successfully. Worker memory-retention fixes are complete: all 118 tests passed, 7 skipped. CLI billing filters were centralized; all 15 CLI and 22 command tests passed, and invoice-list help now has one `--currency/-c`. Exact outputs should be retained in future updates.
